name: Tajima Kayano
source:
Kayano Tajima is Takahisa Tajima and Ema Tajima's biological mother. Takahisa met his mother one year after the battle of Red Night, after Ema arranged a surprise family reunion. She is in poor health and can only live for another five years.

[From the [url=http://11eyes.wikia.com/wiki/Main_Page]11eyes wiki[/url].]
